1 · Operation — when and for what purpose?

Purpose is derived from the three-way valve and active heat sources. It identifies the receiving circuit; scheduler and mode events below provide additional trigger context.

2 · DHW — request and result

DHW activity is shaded. Tank temperature is the result; tank setpoint is the request.

3 · Room heating — request and result

Room-heating activity is shaded. A room target is shown only when Zone 1 uses room-temperature control.

4 · Heating water circuit — delivered temperature

Target, flow and return temperatures show what the heating circuit received. Curve shift or direct-water request is included only when applicable.

6 · COP during operation

The selected-period COP cards use integrated energy totals. Short-interval COP points are diagnostic and can fluctuate.
